description: Two-device live demo (decision 0042, ticket T-54): one coordinator on laptop A schedules eight physical Docker nodes, four per laptop. Laptop B runs only a node agent. Demo settings are not scored figures.

serversPerNode.source: Demo choice: three worker slots per container, so a house runs up to three tasks at once and can take several moved tasks per step (the year simulation uses 12.5 servers per house, config/reference-house.json).

fillerAvailability.source: Year-simulation default phi = 1 (decision 0025): Type 2 research filler is always available, so a house that wants heat always has work; Type 1 jobs go first.

minimumLoadShare.source: Demo setting: permit pause down to zero for visible control; matches the year explorer comparison scenario in config/reference-house.json.

allowedCpuCoresPerContainer.source: Demo setting: 1.5 Docker CPUs per house = 3 servers x 0.5 core at full load (6 cores for four houses), limited by compose.live-demo.yml; not a 1 kW power measurement.

targetTemperatureMinC.source: Demo mapping choice: lower endpoint of the illustrative slider (no heat wanted); not a measured room temperature.

targetTemperatureMaxC.source: Demo mapping choice: upper endpoint (full heat of one server wanted); not a measured room temperature.

stepSeconds.source: Demo choice: one scheduler hour is shown as 2 s, so new work is distributed within about 2 s.

serverHoursPerTask.source: Own single-slot Docker measurement on this laptop, 2026-11-21: 5,000 measurement + 500 thermalisation sweeps at --cpus 0.5 took 3.719, 4.025, 4.007 s (median 4.007 s); one model server-hour is 2 wall seconds. See config/live-demo-scale.json.

taskSweeps.source: Own Docker measurement on this laptop, 2026-11-21: 5000 measurement + 500 thermalisation sweeps at --cpus 0.5 took 3.719, 4.025, 4.007 s; command and measurement basis in config/live-demo-scale.json.

tasksPerJob.source: docs/jobs/research-sim.md: one Ising scan has 16 temperatures x 2 seeds = 32 independently executable tasks. This demo executes all 32, at a shorter measured sweep count per task.

deadlineSteps.source: Synthetic demo scenario, not a customer deadline: 20 scheduler hours = 40 wall seconds; 32 tasks x 2 server-hours = 64 server-hours, which exceeds one full three-slot node's 60 server-hours before due time, so redistribution is necessary.

forecastHorizonSteps.source: Demo choice: horizon of the persistence forecast passed to the scheduler (the LP plans over it; B2 uses only the current hour).

autoSpawnEverySteps.source: Demo choice: when auto-spawn is on, one new job arrives every 10 steps (20 s) (about half of the four nodes' capacity at medium heat) at a node drawn with the seed below.

seed.source: Fixed seed for reproducible auto-spawn and task seeds.
